joints.why: P1 R1 weights round 19: the hanging arm keyed AT THE GAME POSE (correctives.game_a_key): B posed as the game poses it in a shot, laid on A's surface as the game poses A in the same shot (rest twins, where B's rest lies on A). The right arm's close-up key is left out: 9.4 deg from the Look's, it made the RBF ill-conditioned (|M| 6.9, the Look shape at full weight 45 deg from its key); the Look shape alone holds the close-up within 1-3 mm. Mask from the upper arm's rest head: 2 cm under it, 11/12/12 cm, full inside half (the top of the cap up to the trapezius: at 11 cm tall the left cap kept 12 mm at its top). Round 27 (gate judge 1 item 5, the raised-arm deltoid peak in fights): four raised fight keys in the same RBF, so the solve holds the hang shapes at 0 there (before, arm_hang_close_larm fired 0.5-0.74 at fight_close 206, the arm out and back 21-29 deg from the close key in the clavicle's frame, and lifted the cap 20 mm off A): fight_stalker 302 right arm (the most raised, 92 deg from the torso's down), fight_close 206 left (76; the same pose as fight_stalker 366) and fight_close 342 left (79) and fight_close 370 right (84; with three keys it sat 27 deg from 342's and took 0.44 of it, cap 21 -> 31 mm); greedy picks 25+ deg apart over all 48 fight samples raised 70+ deg (r1c/round27/s/raised.py: every sample within 22.5 deg of a key), 26-132 deg apart, 29+ from the hang keys.
